comparison.objective: Scribe a shelf end to match an out-of-flat wall using a pencil compass.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual workpiece stabilization and continuous wall-following that transfers a varying profile.
comparison.success_condition: Required stations match the wall-derived target within tolerance, including curvature evidence; compass and shelf finish stable and released.
comparison.reason: Tests surface following and profile transcription. Continuous contact is shared only generically; there is no insertion, raceway continuity, or loose-element containment.
